notes:
benchmarking_db 578: adjudicate the remaining unlabeled pure-ftpd findings (the 90% task 551's 10% sample left), whole-daemon scope src/** + puredb/** per the task-551/717 scope declaration in data/benchmark_repos.json.

METHOD. Population = Postgres realworld run 261 (sqc-0.4.336-96c59c64, queued by dev-41 on main 2026-09-18 10:11, the newest run at pickup); pureftpd codebase_commit cc28bff5 equals the pinned checkout on dev-468 (bench corpus-check OK, tree clean apart from 3 untracked non-C build files). Keys pulled with BenchDB._run_violation_keys(261) -- the same (relpath, line, rule) basis score_realworld_run uses -- then filtered through aurora-lint's bench.corpus.in_scope (all 4610 keys are in scope: the scope declaration is src/**+puredb/** with no excludes), then diffed against BOTH Postgres ground_truth at that commit AND benchmark_adjudication main's pureftpd CSV (17 keys were labeled on main but not yet synced to Postgres; excluded). Result: 4610 keys, 2801 labeled in Postgres, 17 repo-only, 1792 unlabeled -- NOT the ~5,021 in the task body, which predates the per-rule delta passes that have labeled pureftpd since 2026-08-25 (DCL06-C, EXP34-C, PRE02-C, MSC41-C, DCL13-C, ERR33-C fclose, ...).

SCOPE DECISION (task's own first step): full remaining coverage rather than another sample -- a second sample would leave the same per-file completeness gap that task 596 declined to fragment, and 1792 is bounded. Batched rule-coherently (~110-150 rows, largest rules first), one commit per batch on one branch, so partial progress is still mergeable.

GATE CHECK (CLAUDE.md delta-adjudication step): five rules are HELD BACK because an open aurora_lint task is about to move their population: DCL05-C (25 keys; task 1188's typedef-resolution fix on review/1188-dev468 removes the P*/LP*/*PTR name heuristic that produced pureftpd's 21 labeled FPs, awaiting policy ack), ARR38-C (10; task 748 explicitly gates further ARR38-C adjudication on its research), MEM30-C (9; task 1233 exclusive-branch double-free FPs), MEM31-C (1; tasks 1198/1279/1280 in flight), ENV01-C (67; task 1174 re-examines the trigger condition itself, and pureftpd's existing 27 FP / 0 TP already supplies the evidence it asks for). 112 keys total, listed in the task note, to be adjudicated after those land. Not gated: MSC41-C (task 1177 is a P5 mbedtls note, no fix in flight) and PRE08-C (task 1175 wants evidence; adjudicating supplies it). Coverage target for this task is therefore 1680 keys.

DRIFT NOTE: origin/main is 14 commits past run 261 at pickup; four touch rules (INT32-C 8e95f619, INT33-C cf3ae38c, MEM31-C 7721d6da, ARR30-C 64d14756), which have 0/0/1-gated/0 keys in this population, so run 261 is a sound basis for every batch here.

ADJUDICATION: each finding read in its source context at cc28bff5 (the statement, its enclosing condition/function, and callers where the checked-ness is decided elsewhere), verdicts following the conventions already established in pureftpd's labels for each rule (cited per row where a precedent exists). The rule's own text is the bar; "the project does not care" is a suppression/config matter, not an FP (ADR-0001/0005). Adjudicator: claude-opus-5 on dev-468, single pass, no adversarial re-verification. Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision/recall claim is made here.
BATCH B1 of 13: ERR33-C, the first 140 of its 210 unlabeled keys in (file, line) order (puredb/, altlog.c ... ptracetest.c); B2 holds the remaining 70 plus ERR30-C.

RESULT: 95 FP / 45 TP.
- The FP mass is one analyzer gap, seen 80+ times: an assign-and-check inside the same if-condition ('if ((p = malloc(n)) == NULL)', including multi-line '||' chains and '!(t = gmtime(...))') is reported as unchecked. This is the dominant driver the task body predicted (EXP34-C/ERR33-C credit gap). A dozen more are checks on the next line ('ret = sscanf(...); if (ret != 2)'), a later range check that covers the error indicator (umask > 0777, SITE IDLE > MAX_SITE_IDLE, ALLO size < 0 after an off_t cast), a check on the aliased field later in the function (pw_.pw_dir, pwret.pw_passwd), or a value returned straight to callers that all test it (pw_ldap_getvalue).
- TPs are the shapes the existing pureftpd ERR33-C labels already call TP: bare snprintf/vsnprintf with no SNCHECK (23, several building paths or reply lines), raw strtoul/strtoull into quota/bandwidth/ratio fields with no errno/endptr/range check or only a 'q > 0' business filter (13), bare fflush (5), bare fclose (2), putenv (2), an ignored sscanf on SITE UTIME, an ignored strftime, an unchecked time(NULL) feeding idle arithmetic, and an unchecked strdup(DEFAULT_SHELL) fallback.
